envelope_additional_properties_note: The pinned envelope schema declares additionalProperties: true at the top level. An unknown top-level receipt field is therefore NOT rejected by the envelope or profile Boolean verdicts today. It DOES change receipt_artifact_hash, because that hash covers the complete receipt object. This contract preserves that existing, documented behavior rather than silently tightening it.
out_of_scope_note: This contract binds only the DAGR MCP receipt-emitter/runtime binding's supported profile, srs.mcp.sdk_enforcement.v0.1, and its admission/outcome receipt kinds. srs.connection.lifecycle.v0.1 and its receipt kinds (connect, scope_grant, retention_selection, revoke, delete) are out of scope for this v0.1 report/execution-record contract. Building a report for any other profile selection or receipt_kind is refused (raises), not silently reported.
